To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have produced a fully substituted seleno-methionyl version and crystals of the bacteriophage φ6 P2 RNA-dependent RNA polymerases.

(i) we have cloned and overexpressed the bacteriophage RNA-dependent RNA polymerases in Escherichiah coli; (ii) we have produced selenomethione-substituted proteins; (iii) we have grown crystals of both proteins; (iv) we have determined the unit-cell dimensions and space group of the crystals; and (v) we have determined that the crystals diffract to 3 A.

1) we have cloned, overexpressed and purified an active RNA-dependent RNA polymerases (RDRP) from bacteriophages Φ6; 2) we have grown crystals of the enzyme that diffract to 2.5 Å resolution; and 3) we are in the process of determining the structure of the RDRPs using X-ray crystallography.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the structure and mechanism of the bacteriophage RNA-dependent RNA polymerases (RDRP) and their interaction with the viral RNA genome.
the structural characterization of the bacteriophage Phi6 RNA-dependent RNA-dependent polymerase (RdRp), the key enzyme in viral replication, using X-ray crystallography.
the development of a crystal structure for the bacteriophage φ6 RNA-dependent RNA-polymerase.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the P2 polymerase crystallizes in two different space groups, which are morphologically indistinguished, and that the two forms are in equilibrium with one another.
the crystals of P2 belong to the monocline space group, P2 1, with two molecules in the asymmetric unit.
the P21 crystals contain two molecules per asymmetric unit and that the P3 crystals contain one molecule per asymmetric unit.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have been able to crystallize a protein that is a member of the largest family of proteins in the database (the polymerase family), but for which no other structure is known.
the crystals are not very good and that they diffract very weakly.
, although we have not yet been able to solve the structure, our preliminary data are encouraging.
The main takeaway from our work is that

, in order to obtain crystals of a protein that are suitable for high-resolution structure determination, one needs to be prepared to grow crystals of many different types, and to collect data to high resolution from each crystal type.
the RNA-dependent RNA polymerases from the bacteriophages Φ6 and Φ8 are very similar in structure, and are also similar in structure to the RNA-dependent RNA replicases from the coronaviruses.
the crystallization of the P2 protein has been optimized and a high-resolution structure of the protein should be obtainable.
